Below are the regular‑season win totals for each of the most recent World Series champions that I can confirm from publicly available records. (My training data only go up through mid‑2024, so I don’t have the 2024 champion’s win total.)

| Season | World Series Champion | Regular‑season Wins* |
|--------|----------------------|----------------------|
| 2023   | Texas Rangers        | 90 |
| 2022   | Houston Astros       | 106 |
| 2021   | Atlanta Braves       | 88 |
| 2020*  | Los Angeles Dodgers  | 43 (60‑game season) |
| 2019   | Washington Nationals | 93 |

\*The 2020 MLB season was shortened to 60 games because of the COVID‑19 pandemic, so the Dodgers’ win total reflects that abbreviated schedule.

The 2024 World Series concluded after the end of my knowledge cutoff (June 2024), and my internal data do not contain the champion’s regular‑season win total. If you need that figure, a quick look at the 2024 MLB standings (or a reliable sports news source) will give you the exact number.
